name: Music & Praise
summary: Lifting our voices in song, from beloved hymns to gospel praise that stirs the soul.
details: Our choir and musicians lead the congregation in worship every Sunday. If the Lord has given you a voice or an instrument, there is a place for you here.

name: Prayer Ministry
summary: Standing in the gap for our church, our families, and our community through faithful prayer.
details: Our prayer warriors lift up every request shared with the church. You can send a prayer request through our contact page at any time, and it will be prayed over with care.

name: Christian Education
summary: Sunday School and Bible study for every age, building lives on the foundation of Scripture.
details: Classes meet before Sunday worship, and Bible study meets midweek. Come ready to learn, ask questions, and grow in the knowledge of God's Word.

name: Outreach & Missions
summary: Sharing the love of Christ beyond our walls through community service and missions support.
details: We serve our neighbors in Baldwin Park, West Covina, and beyond, and we support missions that carry the Gospel around the world.

name: Seniors' Fellowship
summary: Honoring our seasoned saints with fellowship, encouragement, and care for one another.
details: Our seniors are the heart of this church. We gather for fellowship, check in on one another, and make sure no one is forgotten.

name: Family & Youth
summary: Helping the next generation know and love the Lord, and strengthening families in faith.
details: Children and young people are always welcome. We teach them the Word, pray over them, and walk alongside their families.
